feature_name: Apigee and hybrid plugin instance management
summary: Adds create and delete operations for Apigee and Apigee Hybrid plugin instances linked to corresponding runtime projects.

supporting_pages.title: Manage custom plugins \_|\_ Apigee \_|\_ Google Cloud Documentation
evidence_snippets: Before you begin Grant the following IAM permissions to your principal account: apihub.plugins.create apihub.plugins.delete apihub.plugins.get apihub.plugins.list For information on granting roles to principals, see Granting, changing, and revoking access .
Once the plugin is created, you can create a plugin instance to establish the connection and ingest the third party API data into API hub.
Before deleting a plugin, you must ensure to delete all the plugin instances associated with it.
